recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in FHIR core unless a future human review identifies a separate rendered-output generation issue.
issue_request: FHIR-17368 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I change request for the Request logical pattern. It reported that the business-identifier note was misaligned on Request.instantiatesCanonical and requested moving that text to Request.identifier notes.
initial_application: No prior commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17368 or GF#17368 was found in local git history. The current source already contains the requested note under Request.identifier, and history around the later R5 instantiates removal shows the note was already present there before Request.instantiatesCanonical was removed.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request in the active [logical] section, so source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml is current build-scope source for the Request pattern. Later published FHIR-32897 work, applied in git commit 2ee637a94c1abc09d0ab102e1f1a655a7292322d, removed the Request/Event instantiates elements. Community searches found only the original Zulip tracker bot notification and no substantive Zulip or Confluence discussion changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The text FHIR-17368 asked to move is already in the correct Request.identifier comment location, and the original Request.instantiatesCanonical location no longer exists in the current Request pattern source.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 Request/Event pattern work removed the instantiates elements, including the original Request.instantiatesCanonical location referenced by FHIR-17368.
